verdict.rationale: Sentry ships Seer, a built-in debugging agent. It automatically root-causes and triages incoming issues, generates code fixes and opens PRs via Autofix, reviews code changes in GitHub/GitLab, and answers free-form questions about your telemetry. Users can also delegate work to it by assigning Sentry Agent to Linear issues or launching Cursor Cloud Agents from Seer. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Seer's task delegation, and in-depth documentation of how delegated tasks are scoped, supervised, and approved inside the product.
